interaction.describe.mobile: Tap to open an app; hold for 0.45 s for the menu (including Select for batch actions); hold then slide to drag; swipe empty space to switch pages.
interaction.describe.windows: Click to select, double-click to open, hold to drag, drag a box on empty space to multi-select.
msg.rescan.body: Scan finished: {added} added, {removed} stale entries cleaned up.

onboarding.dock.body:
Drag a shortcut, exe or URL from Explorer onto the Dock to add it; right-click a Dock icon to remove or reorder.

Position, icon size and spacing, corner radius and opacity live in Settings ▸ Dock.
onboarding.dock.title: Dock: everyday apps within reach
onboarding.folder.body: Drag one icon onto another and release — they merge into a folder. Open it to drag more items in or out; pull everything out and the folder dissolves.
onboarding.folder.title: Drop an icon onto another to make a folder
onboarding.icons.body:
Double-click to launch. Hold and drag to rearrange; drag to the top or bottom edge and pause to flip pages. The mouse wheel works on empty space too.

Multi-select: drag a box on empty space, or Ctrl+click items one by one.
onboarding.icons.title: Icons: double-click to open, drag to move
onboarding.pages.body: When the desktop fills up it pages automatically. The dots at the bottom are the page tabs — click one to jump. Icons and widgets slide over together.
onboarding.pages.title: Multiple pages: the dots are tabs
onboarding.settings.body:
Right-click empty desktop space, or right-click the tray icon → Settings: language, icon size, grid columns, Dock and widgets are all there.

You can replay this tour from Settings ▸ General → “Show quick tour”.
onboarding.settings.title: Everything is changeable
onboarding.welcome.body:
This turns the Windows desktop into a phone-style home screen: icons you can drag anywhere and page through, a Dock for your everyday apps, and widgets like clock, notes and system monitor right on the desktop.

The next few pages cover the essentials — about a minute.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to ZhangJing Desktop
onboarding.widgets.body: Hold a widget to move it, hold its bottom-right corner to resize. For more, open Settings ▸ Widget library and click “Add to desktop”.
onboarding.widgets.title: Widgets: clock, notes, system monitor
